item.tib: byams ma'i dkyil chog so so'i gnad kyi bya tshul shel dkar me long
item.coloph: zhes byams ma chen mo'i dkyil chog nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rim pa so sor bya tshul nyung bsdus shel dkar me long 'di yang mkhan ming pa nyi ri shel bzhin gyis/ rang gi gcung po skam rigs bon po khro rgyal bkra shis kyis/ 'di ltar dgos zhes bskul ba yid la bcag bzhin/ slar sman ri bla brang du byams ma'i yig sna tshang bar go rtogs legs par gzhigs te brtsams pa dge bar gyur cig/
